contract.task_clause:
Which of the following was a direct result of the First Opium War of 1839-1842?
Option A: The Chinese commissioner of trade in Canton (Guangzhou) banned the opium trade in that city.
Option B: China was forced to open some of its ports to international trade.
Option C: Chinese revolutionaries toppled the Qing dynasty.
Option D: Chinese leaders set out to remake their economy along Western lines.
